onboarding_steps_app_password:
Turn on two-step verification in your account''s security settings
Create an app password
Copy it and paste it below
onboarding_steps_authorization_code:
In your mailbox on the web, open Settings → POP3/SMTP/IMAP
Turn on the IMAP/SMTP service
Generate an authorization code and copy it here
onboarding_steps_client_password:
In Exmail, check Settings → Client settings for secure login
If it is on, create a client-specific password and copy it here
onboarding_steps_qq:
In QQ Mail on the web, open Settings → Account
Turn on the IMAP/SMTP service
Generate an authorization code and copy it here
onboarding_sync: How much mail to sync first
onboarding_sync_help: Older mail loads when you scroll to it

outbox_state_sent: Sent, waiting to file in Sent
reader_ai_quick: Quick replies · pick one, then edit it in the composer
reader_avatar_blocked: Blocked the sender avatar; loading may contact the sender''s website and Gravatar
reader_remote_blocked: Blocked {arg1, number, ::group-off} remote images so the sender can''t tell whether you opened this message

settings_about_license: Open source under the Apache-2.0 license
settings_account_clear_cache_body: Downloaded attachments are deleted from this computer and download again when opened.
settings_account_mailbox_archive_help: Mail moves here when you press Archive
settings_account_mailbox_drafts_help: Mail you have not finished is kept here
settings_account_mailbox_help: Servers usually mark which folder is Drafts, Sent and Junk, and Godwit picks them up; if it gets one wrong, change it here. Purging deletes mail from the server for good, so your other devices lose it too.
settings_account_make_default_help: Used when writing from All Inboxes
settings_account_purge_blocked: The server lacks UIDPLUS, so nothing is purged
settings_account_purge_junk_help: Junk older than this is deleted for good
settings_account_purge_trash_help: Deleted mail older than this is deleted for good
settings_account_reauth: The sign-in has expired and syncing stopped {arg1}. Mail on this computer can still be read and searched; mail you write stays in the outbox and goes out once you sign in again.
settings_account_reauth_browser: Sign in again in the browser
settings_account_reauth_unknown: The sign-in has expired and syncing has stopped. Mail on this computer can still be read and searched; mail you write stays in the outbox and goes out once you sign in again.
settings_account_remove_help: Clears this computer''s mail cache, drafts and keychain credentials. Mail on the server is not affected.
settings_account_remove_row: Remove this account from this computer
settings_account_servers_help: Change the addresses, ports and encryption by hand
settings_account_signature_help: Added to the end of mail you write. Wit never changes it. You can use bold, links and images (like a company logo).
settings_account_signature_image_invalid: Images must be PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 512 KB, at most 4
settings_body_font_size_help: Only the body of the mail you read
settings_ext_config_sub: · form generated from the plugin''s config declaration
settings_ext_native_reviewed_body: Native plugins share Godwit''s system permissions and can access mail, account credentials, local files and the network, and run programs.
settings_ext_mcp_grant_help: Once approved, Godwit starts this server and Wit can call its tools.
settings_ext_mcp_kv_help: One KEY=VALUE per line; values are kept in the system keychain. Editing shows the keys only; an empty value keeps the stored one.
settings_ext_mcp_remove_body: The server''s settings and the values kept in the keychain are deleted.
settings_ext_mcp_trust_help: Once trusted, it needs approval only after Wit has read mail
settings_ext_native_risk_body: A native plugin can read your mail, account credentials and files on this computer, reach any network address, run programs, and can crash Godwit. Godwit cannot restrict it.
settings_ext_native_risk_title: Runs with all of Godwit''s permissions
settings_ext_native_trust_unlisted: This file is not in Godwit''s reviewed plugin directory. Enable it only if you trust where it came from.
settings_ext_native_trust_user: You allowed this file. It needs your permission again if it changes.
settings_ext_perm_llm: Call the language model (judging questions may go to a different vendor)
settings_ext_perm_translate: Gets the mail you translate and may send it to the addresses above
settings_ext_registry_confirm_body: This file was reviewed for Godwit''s plugin directory. Its integrity is checked before installation. Native plugins share Godwit''s system permissions and can access mail, account credentials, local files and the network, and run programs.
settings_ext_registry_confirm_replace: It replaces the {arg1} you installed yourself.
settings_ext_registry_empty: The plugin directory has no plugins yet.
settings_ext_registry_stale: The plugin directory could not be updated; this is what it listed last time.
settings_ext_revoked: Godwit''s plugin directory no longer trusts this file.
settings_ext_sub: Skills are just prompts; script plugins run in a sandbox with only the permissions you approve, native plugins have all of Godwit''s; MCP gives Wit outside tools.
settings_ext_uninstall_body: The plugin''s files and settings are deleted.
settings_keep_in_background: Keep running after the window closes
settings_keep_in_background_help: Keeps syncing and notifying; open it again from the menu bar icon
settings_labels_auto_on_help: Sorts new mail in the background, Inbox only
settings_labels_delete_confirm_help: It will be removed from {arg1, number, ::group-off} messages.
settings_labels_desc_placeholder: Say which mail counts, e.g. mail from my parents and my kid’s school
settings_labels_dialog_sub: The model uses the name and description to decide which mail gets this label.
settings_labels_list_foot: Drag to reorder; the sidebar and menus follow this order
settings_labels_model_help: Without a judge model the generation model answers, more slowly
settings_labels_name_exists: A label with this name exists
settings_labels_no_desc: No description; judged by name only
settings_labels_rescan_missing_help: Mail with labels stays as is
settings_labels_rescan_no_model: No model can sort mail yet; add one in Model services first
settings_labels_rescan_redo_help: Model labels are judged again; yours are kept
settings_labels_rescan_sub: After adding or changing labels, sort Inbox mail again with the current labels
settings_labels_sub: The model labels new mail for you, and you can change labels any time. Your changes are never overwritten.
settings_launch_at_login_help: Starts Godwit in the background after login
settings_local_api_help: When on, scripts and AI tools on this computer can reach Godwit through the Local API. The full Local API can read mail, send mail, and change accounts and settings; AI tools connected through MCP (`godwit mcp`) can only read mail and create drafts, never send. Turn it on only if you trust the programs running on this computer.
settings_models_api_key_help: Kept in the system keychain; never shown in the interface or logs.
settings_models_caps_note: One key can turn on both
settings_models_del_confirm: Delete “{arg1}”? Skills using it fall back to the default model, and its key is removed from the keychain.
settings_models_dialog_desc: Pick a provider, enter its key, then decide whether it generates, judges, or both. A service can offer several formats; pick one for each capability.
settings_models_dialog_desc_sub: Sign in with a ChatGPT or SuperGrok plan you already have; no API key needed. The generating model judges too.
settings_models_empty_desc: Summaries, translation, writing, Wit and smart views all need at least one service that can generate. OpenAI, Anthropic, TypeSafe and compatible services such as OpenRouter or a local gateway are supported.
settings_models_fail_no_api: This key has no access to the {arg1} API
settings_models_fail_not_eligible: This ChatGPT account isn''t eligible for subscription sharing
settings_models_fetch_failed: Fetching /models failed ({arg1}). This service may not list its models; you can enter a model ID instead.

settings_models_foot: Capabilities marked ✓ are the ones used by default.
settings_models_hint: Once the API key is filled in, the available models are fetched from /models; click to select, or enter a model ID.
settings_models_hint_sub: Once signed in, the models come from /models; click to pick, or type a model ID.
settings_models_judge_desc: Classification, notification filtering, code detection and action routing. Answers only predefined questions, an order of magnitude faster than generating.
settings_models_judge_hint: Once the API key is filled in, the judge models are fetched from /models.
settings_models_judge_unsupported: {arg1} has no judge API; the generate model answers instead.
settings_models_key_ph_other: Leave empty if there is none

settings_models_need_cap: Turn on at least one capability
settings_models_need_failed_add: A test failed; you can still add it and fix it later
settings_models_need_failed_save: A test failed; you can still save and fix it later
settings_models_need_key: Enter the API key to add it
settings_models_need_model: Select at least one model to generate with
settings_models_no_list: Fetching /models failed. This service may not list its models; you can enter a model ID instead.
settings_models_off_gen_alt: It is the default generate model. Once off, summaries, translation, writing and Wit use {arg1}.
settings_models_off_gen_only: It is the only service that generates; once off, summaries, translation, writing and Wit are unavailable.
settings_models_off_judge: It is the default judge model. Once off, the generate model answers judge questions, more slowly.
settings_models_sub: Generation writes; judging classifies and routes. One service can do both.
settings_models_tile_grok: Your SuperGrok or X Premium plan
settings_models_use_alert: {arg1}, used for generation, can''t connect ({arg2}): summaries, translation, writing and Wit are unavailable
settings_models_use_gen_desc: Summaries, translation, writing and Wit chats.
settings_models_use_gen_none: Not set up: these features are unavailable for now
settings_models_use_judge_desc: Classification, notification filtering, code detection and action routing.
settings_models_use_small_desc: Summaries, translation and quick replies can use a cheaper model
settings_models_use_suggest: Add OpenAI Decisions or TypeSafe to judge an order of magnitude faster.
settings_no_translate_help: Mail in these languages shows no translation offer
settings_notify_preview_help: Off, notifications say only that new mail arrived
settings_privacy_sub: Your mail and credentials stay on this computer.
settings_quick_replies_help: Offer a few short replies to mail you receive
settings_reading_language_help: Summaries, translations and Wit''s answers use this language
settings_remote_images_avatars: Remote image settings also apply to sender avatars. When automatic loading is allowed, new messages fetch avatars in advance. Old messages, cache misses or expired entries, and manual loading may still contact sender websites and Gravatar while you read. They can see this computer''s IP address and may infer your reading time. Gravatar queries use an email hash.
settings_remote_images_cache_help: New mail’s images are fetched on arrival; cached ones show offline
settings_remote_images_mode_help: Images in Junk never load by themselves
settings_remote_images_sub: Godwit downloads a message’s images for you, without cookies or a referrer, so senders cannot tell when you read it when the images were fetched as the mail arrived (they still see this computer’s IP address when an image is fetched)
settings_reply_language_help: Used when Wit and quick replies draft mail. Defaults to the incoming mail''s language; new mail follows the recipient''s earlier mail
settings_secret_kept: Configured · leave empty to keep it
settings_summary_help: Summarize mail as you open it; needs a model service
settings_theme_help: Follows macOS appearance when set to System
settings_thread_view_help: Group mail of the same conversation together
settings_translator_help: Plugins need to be enabled in Extensions
settings_trusted_none: No trusted senders yet. Choose “Always trust this sender” on a message''s remote image notice to add one
settings_trusted_sub: Remote images from these senders load automatically, except in Junk
settings_unread_in_menu_bar: Show the unread count in the menu bar
settings_unread_on_app_icon: Show the unread count on the app icon

wit_compose_empty: Write it yourself, or tell Wit on the right how to reply

wit_compose_writing_banner: The assistant is writing the body; it cannot be edited for now
wit_placeholder: Ask something, like: who is still waiting for my reply from last week?
